description: This file contains a helper function 'test_create_unique_files' designed to create multiple directories and files with unique contents for testing purposes. The function takes three parameters: number of directories, number of files per directory, and the base directory. It first validates input, sets up local variables, cleans the base directory, and creates directories and files with unique named contents based on a timestamp and counters.

methods.name: test_create_unique_files
methods.description: Creates specified number of directories and files with unique contents within a given base directory, using counters and timestamps to ensure contents are unique across invocations.
